title: Porkchop merge decisions
description: Dedicated layouts for the decisions added by the Porkchop911 merge, which had no UI. Synthetic gallery fixtures, not captured engine states.

shots.heading: Ground hit: sustain damage
shots.caption: An effect (Deorbit Barrage and similar) assigned a hit to a named ground force. The card shows the unit with its icon, and the planet with its system, and each answer says what it does: Sustain damage keeps the unit, damaged; Let it be destroyed removes it. Before, this was a bare 'use SUSTAIN DAMAGE' / decline list.

shots.heading: Crimson commander: gain or convert
shots.caption: After a combat the commander pays its holder. The card prints the commander (Ahk Siever) with its ability, shows the commodities and trade goods held, and each answer says what it does (commodities 1 → 2, or commodities 1 → 0 and trade goods 4 → 5). Before, two plain labels.

shots.heading: Deepwrought commander: gain or convert
shots.caption: The same layout for Aello, paid to the holder when another seat takes 1 off its research cost.

shots.heading: Deepwrought commander: reduce research
shots.caption: The researcher's side of the same card: the commander as printed, the research cost before and after (4 → 3) and what each answer does (Reduce the cost by 1 pays the holder; Pay in full pays nobody).

shots.heading: Research waiver: ignore prerequisites
shots.caption: A faction ability (Yin's commander, the Cabal's Riftmeld) lets a seat research a technology without its prerequisites. The card names the technology and says what the choice is; the engine's own label for each waiver is kept, capitalised.

shots.heading: Research waiver: choose the payment
shots.caption: The second step: the card names the technology and the waiver being paid for, and lists the legal payments. Declining researches nothing and pays nothing.
